items.reason: Leveled readers for the after-school tutoring sites are tutoring books, which the foundation grant allows. The federal subaward may not pay for the tutoring program.
Phonics app licenses for federal literacy program classrooms are software licenses used in Program classrooms, which the federal subaward allows.

"Strategy services" from a consultant doesn't say which program it benefits. The federal subaward needs a written agreement describing deliverables, and the foundation needs prior written approval for contractors.
items.missingEvidence: A signed written agreement or scope of work with Brightpath Consulting describing deliverables that benefit the Program (and the Foundation's prior written approval, if it is to be charged to GRANT-FDN).

items.reason: A staff appreciation dinner with wine is staff entertainment and includes alcohol, which both grants prohibit.
Snacks for after-school tutoring students are expressly allowed by the foundation grant.
Printer toner and paper are office supplies, a general operating cost neither grant may pay for, so it belongs on unrestricted funds.
Office electricity is a utility, a general operating cost neither grant may pay for, so it belongs on unrestricted funds.
A venue deposit for a fundraising gala is a fundraising cost, which both grants prohibit.
Workbooks for the federal literacy program's grades 2-3 are instructional materials for Program classrooms, which the federal subaward allows.
An organization-wide Zoom subscription is a general operating cost not tied to Program classrooms, so it belongs on unrestricted funds.

Maria's job and planned split include the after-school tutoring program, but her October timesheet shows zero tutoring hours (120 federal, 40 admin). The 30% foundation share is only a budget estimate, which is not support for a charge.
items.missingEvidence: Corrected October time records for Maria Lopez showing the hours she actually worked on each program, including after-school tutoring.

items.reason: James's timesheet (96 hours tutoring supervision, 64 hours federal program) matches his job description, so the split follows his logged hours.
Priya runs finance, HR and facilities, and all 160 of her hours are general operations, so her pay belongs on unrestricted funds.
